construction: 21 parts in 3 steps. Step 1: a 4×6 plate on two 1×4 wheel-pin plates, two 3×1 33° slopes and a 4H antenna. Step 2: the 30134 staircase with a locking hinge arm and plate and a jumper plate. Step 3: four 6.4×8 rims with tyres, a 4×4 landing plate and two 1×4×1 panels as rails.
interfaces: Studs up; the staircase is one moulded part. Free-standing: nothing connects it to the aircraft, the parent only positions it at the door.
lesson: Rolling boarding stairs for a minifigure airliner: a dedicated 7×4×6 open staircase part on a 4×6 plate with wheel-pin plates and four small wheels, a 4×4 landing plate with two 1×4 panels as rails and an antenna as the handrail post.
parent_context: `7893 - main.ldr` places it at (168, −32, −332) turned 90° about Y, beside the open forward door of the airliner.
reuse_notes: Use it as ground equipment beside any minifigure airliner door; set the landing height to the door sill before choosing the base plates.
